name: mor-dub
description: Dub: an identity window (make one, its chain key's words shown once; bring one by its signing key's words; switch; a display name), then a public tab (the feed of one's own posts and the followed, posting, replies, follow and mute, what is addressed to you) and a private tab (the inbox, sealed messages). On the Mac, a program and its page; on the web (dub.dubsar.org), the same page running in the browser, for testing only (F281). Test identities only, until MOR is frozen.
